disabled_publishing.description: Whether to disable publishing of services — set via avahi-daemon.conf, not avahi-discover.

disable_user_service_publishing.description: Whether to disable publishing of user services — set via avahi-daemon.conf, not avahi-discover.

mdns_client_enabled.description: Whether mDNS client is enabled via libnss-mdns — required for .local name resolution.

multicast_interface.description: Network interface used for multicast traffic; configured via avahi-daemon.conf or ifconfig, not avahi-discover.
